WITH first_approved_loan AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE status = 'approved'
    ORDER BY date ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
client_account_balance AS (
    SELECT t1.client_id, t2.account_id, t3.balance, t3.date
    FROM client AS t1
    JOIN disp AS t2 ON t1.client_id = t2.client_id
    JOIN trans AS t3 ON t2.account_id = t3.account_id
    WHERE t1.client_id IN (
        SELECT t2.client_id
        FROM disp AS t2
        JOIN loan AS t3 ON t2.account_id = t3.account_id
        WHERE t3.status = 'approved' AND t3.date >= '1993-07-05'
        ORDER BY t3.date ASC
        LIMIT 1
    )
    AND t3.date BETWEEN '1993-03-22' AND '1998-12-27'
),
balance_changes AS (
    SELECT client_id, account_id, 
           LAG(balance, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY client_id, account_id ORDER BY date) AS prev_balance,
           balance,
           date
    FROM client_account_balance
)
SELECT ((t2.balance - t1.prev_balance) / t1.prev_balance) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM balance_changes AS t1
JOIN balance_changes AS t2 ON t1.client_id = t2.client_id AND t1.account_id = t2.account_id
WHERE t1.date < '1998-12-27' AND t2.date > '1993-03-22'
